Tests setting and clearing multiple breakpoints within functions.
--- Function f (single line) ---
() {[B0]a=1;b=2}
() {a=1;b=2}
() {a=1;[B0]b=2}
() {[B0]a=1;[B1]b=2}
() {[B0]a=1;[B1]b=2[B2]}
() {[B0]a=1;b=2[B1]}
() {a=1;b=2[B0]}
() {a=1;b=2}
--- Function g (multi-line) ---
() {
  [B0]a=1;
  b=2;
}
() {
  a=1;
  b=2;
}
() {
  a=1;
  [B0]b=2;
}
() {
  [B0]a=1;
  [B1]b=2;
}
() {
  [B0]a=1;
  [B1]b=2;
[B2]}
() {
  [B0]a=1;
  b=2;
[B1]}
() {
  a=1;
  b=2;
[B0]}
() {
  a=1;
  b=2;
}
